title: US-Contracted Vessel Struck by Iranian Drones and Missile Near Strait of Hormuz
detail: A vessel contracted by the United States, with several American personnel aboard, was struck by an Iranian drone-and-missile barrage while transiting near the Strait of Hormuz earlier in the week, according to reports surfacing Sept 16. The assault involved four Iranian drones and at least one missile, with one projectile making direct contact with the ship. The strike caused only minor physical injuries, including smoke inhalation among crew, who were undergoing medical treatment in an undisclosed Gulf country. Neither CENTCOM nor Tehran issued an official statement confirming the incident at the time of reporting.

media.caption: A US-contracted vessel was struck by Iranian drones and a missile near the Strait of Hormuz, reported Sept 16, 2026

confidenceReason: Reported via unnamed sources by Anadolu Agency and The Express Tribune, both apparently syndicating the same underlying report; no on-record confirmation from CENTCOM, the US government, or Iran, and the exact date of the strike ('earlier this week') is not pinned down.

title: Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi Travels to Beijing for Talks with China's Wang Yi Amid War with US, Israel
detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Beijing for talks with Wang Yi, director of China's Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs and concurrently foreign minister, China's Foreign Ministry confirmed. The visit comes roughly a week ahead of a planned US-China summit on Sept 24 and follows an earlier Araghchi-Wang meeting on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in New Delhi; analysts said Tehran is seeking diplomatic and economic support from Beijing amid the ongoing war with the US and Israel, with the Iran-US conflict and BRICS cooperation expected to feature in the talks.

sources.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

media.caption: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi visits Beijing for talks with Chinese counterpart Wang Yi, Sept 16, 2026

confidenceReason: Confirmed directly by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, corroborated by CNBC and The Tribune (India).
